overall.summary: Deterministic contract is unscoped. 1 evidence-backed blocker(s); 2 advisory taste note(s).
overall.raw_summary: The HUD is functional but suffers from readability, spacing, and hierarchy issues. Improvements are needed in text clarity, alignment, and visual emphasis to meet shippable quality.

strengths: Consistent panel styles and alignment across the HUD.
Minimap and ability bar are logically placed.
issues: The 'Floor 1' panel is slightly misaligned vertically compared to the minimap.
The 'Floor 1' panel and the minimap feel disconnected due to excessive vertical spacing.
The health bar text is cramped within its container.

strengths: Key elements like the minimap and ability bar are visually distinct.
issues: The 'Floor 1' panel lacks emphasis and blends into the background.
The health bar and currency counters do not stand out enough.

strengths: Pixel font is crisp and thematically appropriate.
issues: The 'HUD Lab' text is too small and low-contrast, making it hard to read.
The health bar text is cramped and difficult to parse quickly.

strengths: Icons for currency and abilities are clear and recognizable.
issues: The minimap lacks any visible markers or context, reducing its utility.

strengths: Font choice is consistent with the pixel art style.
issues: Text in the health bar and 'HUD Lab' area is too small and lacks sufficient contrast.
The 'Floor 1' panel text could use more breathing room.

strengths: The pixel art style is cohesive and matches the game's theme.
Color palette is consistent and appropriate for the setting.
issues: The 'HUD Lab' text feels out of place and does not match the rest of the HUD's style.

blocking_findings: The 'HUD Lab' text is unreadable due to low contrast and small size.
recommended_fixes: Increase the size and contrast of the 'HUD Lab' text to improve readability.
Add more breathing room around the health bar text to make it easier to read.
Reduce the vertical spacing between the 'Floor 1' panel and the minimap to create a more cohesive layout.
Add markers or context to the minimap to make it more useful.

precise_fixes.reason: Text is too small and difficult to read; increasing height will improve legibility.
Text is cramped within the health bar; adding padding will improve readability.
Panel is too far from the minimap; reducing vertical spacing will improve layout cohesion.
